title: AI models on the OpenCode Go plan

columns.label: Model
columns.desc: The model's name, as the OpenCode Go plan lists it.

columns.label: Plan page
columns.desc: The page where the plan states this model's limits (opencode.ai/go).

columns.label: Requests per 5 hours on the OpenCode Go plan
columns.desc: How many requests this model allows in a 5-hour window on the OpenCode Go plan ($10 a month), as the plan page states it.

columns.label: Monthly usage value on the OpenCode Go plan ($)
columns.desc: How much model usage, in US dollars, the OpenCode Go plan ($10 a month) gives for this model each month.

columns.label: Requests per 5 hours on the OpenCode Go Plus plan
columns.desc: How many requests this model allows in a 5-hour window on the OpenCode Go Plus plan ($40 a month), as the plan page states it.

columns.label: Monthly usage value on the OpenCode Go Plus plan ($)
columns.desc: How much model usage, in US dollars, the OpenCode Go Plus plan ($40 a month) gives for this model each month.

columns.label: Answer speed (tokens per second)
columns.desc: Our own measurement: output tokens per second while the model was writing, over 3 timed runs of the same 500-token prompt with no tools, on the EchoLike mini PC. Measured by us, not a vendor figure.

columns.label: Time to first token (milliseconds)
columns.desc: Our own measurement: milliseconds until the model wrote its first token, median of 3 timed runs of the same prompt, no tools, on the EchoLike mini PC.

columns.label: Failed or empty answers (%)
columns.desc: Our own measurement: share of the 3 timed runs in which the model failed, timed out or gave no answer, in percent.

columns.label: Notes
columns.desc: Our editorial notes about this entry.
